latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 1080p promotional videos from your text and/or images—no video editing skills required.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files up to 500MB; describe your desired video and export as MP4.
- Automatic API connection and session setup, including free token generation for new users.
- Simple commands: upload, generate, export video, check credits, and preview timeline.
- Built for marketers, content creators, and small businesses needing fast, ready-to-post videos.
